header: A numbered list where the order matters
lead: Drag the rows to change the ranking. The list numbers itself, so nothing needs renumbering when a row moves.
note: If the gaps between values matter more than the order, use Bar Comparison. For plain labelled numbers, use Figures List.

metrics.title: First place
metrics.text: An optional detail line sits under the name.

metrics.title: Twentieth place, at most
metrics.text: Beyond 20 rows, a ranking turns into a directory.
